title: Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center & One Year in Separate Dorms
description: From a patronizing two-week Vocational Evaluation in Cantor Dorm, Hall Pass red tape, and locked-down Quantum OS 2000 Professional state computers to bonding with middle-aged classmates Tina, Jim, and Sheila, surviving the 'Chickenshit Report' and a stolen admin database mix-up, escaping to Tina's daybed in Luray, and graduating as certified PHP Web Applications Developers.
